title: Animated riffle shuffle of a real deck

credits.credit: Original vector motion authored for this production on the shared win95-workbench-1.1.0 card primitives (tools/render/studio.py); no third-party images, clips or font files included.

tests.result: python tools/validate_delivery.py --id DIA-15 run after this inventory was written; output in the completion report.
byte-identical (riffle is the [0, 12] cut of the main timeline)

first and last authored loop frames are the same file (generator assertion); decoded frames 0 and 119 of loop.mp4 differ only by codec noise (mean abs diff 0.46/255 per channel); renderAt(4) wraps to frame 0.

tests.test: offline HTML, deterministic seek, loop wrap, text canvas bounds

result.mode: Full 1920 x 1080 and 1280 x 720 inspection of the poster and decoded riffle.mp4 frames (0.5, 1.6, 2.47, 3.0, 4.2, 5.9 s) plus loop.mp4 frames 0 and 119
result.scope: Squared deck, split, face flash, two mid-interleave states, squared result; loop first/last frames side by side.
result.status: The halves visibly interleave: two arcs of cards drop alternately into a centre pile whose cards alternate tilt; reads at 720p. Loop endpoints identical. Not every frame was individually reviewed.

toolchain.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 6.0-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2023 the FFmpeg developers
toolchain.cairo: MSYS2 ucrt64 Cairo via CAIROCFFI_DLL_DIRECTORIES; fontconfig fc-match on PATH
toolchain.renderer: python tools/render/render_assets.py --id DIA-15 for the main timeline; src/build_riffle.py encode-loop (same CairoSVG + ffmpeg recipe) for exports/loop.mp4

notes: Stylised top-down riffle: the deck splits, each half releases cards from its top into a centre pile in a deterministic mostly-alternating order (seeded), the ragged pile squares up. Not a physical simulation.
Faces flash on four drops per riffle (8S, 6S, QS, 6H in the main timeline; 8C, 2H, 9C, QS in the loop); every card lands face down.

exports/riffle.mp4 is the 0–12 s cut of the main timeline (identical states to preview.mp4). exports/loop.mp4 is a separate 4 s timeline whose first and last authored frames are identical, encoded by src/build_riffle.py encode-loop with the same CairoSVG + ffmpeg recipe as tools/render/render_assets.py.
Card backs and faces are the shared win95-workbench-1.1.0 primitives (tools/render/studio.py card()) at 240 × 336 px.
Key moments: riffle 2.0 s (the interleave begins), loop 0.1 s (the interleave begins after a 0.1 s apart hold).
Original ticket requirements retained; these exports are not producer publication approval. Review questions are in qa.md.
